I am wearing a well-fitting bra in these shots, but the way the lacy material is attached (loosely and sloppily) makes me look like my girls have seen a lot more decades than they actually have. If you don't believe me, I took a photo right after the others, same perspective and wearing the exact same bra. Do you see the boobies of an old lady in the last shot like you do in the dress shots? I sincerely hope not. I'm not THAT old yet. I can tell that nothing would improve by changing the size of the dress; rather, something is very inherently wrong in how this was stitched together. The boobs are too close together, there's this weird droop happening, huge gaps between the liner and the lace, etc. Unfortunately, I had a million things happening in my life at the time this arrived, and I didn't try it on until 2 months after receiving it, so I can't return it. I guess the one positive thing is that the color is truly lovely. I wish I could wear it without feeling like I lost the battle with gravity decades ago, though!

I am small busted and the top doesn't diminish my bust even further, even without a bra. The only downside is for folks that have a ventless condensation dryer, such as Bosch. The lint this generates on the first wash and dry will have you cleaning the entire condensation system through to the sump pump on the dryer for sure. It's a massive amount. Of course if you have a normal venting dryer, the huge amount of lint can get stuck in the vent pipe. Title: Cute dress. Fit well

Title: Favorite dress

It’s slightly snug, but I m in the process of losing weight. And if I had sized up it would have been loose even if I wasn’t planning on losing any lbs.

It has pockets and a zipper on the left side. The fabric is breathable and comfortable. It fits perfectly and has the perfect length. I paired it with beige sandals and a beige crossbody bag for a casual look. For reference I am 5'1 and got a size extra small. You can also click my name to see my profile for more items I love!

Title: Material is comfortable, great casual dummer dress.
Review: Great casual summer sun dress.

Also the pockets, because the dress is so thin the pockets kind of bowed out so it gave you extra love handles. The material also snagged - but it was single threads that pulled - for being one thread it still was very noticeable - there are better dresses pass on this

I returned all the others and sent the Amazon link for this dress to a few of my girlfriends. I wore it all around paris and it was so comfortable! Wore with tennis shoes one day and heels another. Title: Great dress!

Title: Comfortable
Review: My granddaughter used this dress as a dress for a religious meeting. She also choose to wear a sweater with it

Title: Inconsistent Fit Across Same Silo in this Dress
Review: Ordered this dress in yellow in size small and was very happy with it.  An easy, everyday dress, that was good quality for the price that I paid.  I wore it a few times and liked it so much that I decided to order the same dress in green, in the same size that I ordered in my yellow one.  Unfortunately, did not have the same experience with the green one.  When I tried on the green one, it was obvious that it was completely different specs than my yellow one.  Trying them on side by side, they fit completely different and the green one is much smaller, has a higher neck, and is tighter around the armpits.  While the fabric quality and print were nice, I was so disappointed that I could order the same dress in 2 colors and have such different experiences in fit.

Title: Sizing is Way Off
Review: I wanted to love this dress, but I tried it in three different sizes and they were so off/inconsistent. I first ordered the XL and it was HUGE, big enough for me to think that I could size down two full sizes to a medium. I ordered both the medium and large to try both. The medium was way too small, and the fit of the large was just off - big in places it shouldn't have been and tight in places it shouldn't have been given the style of the dress. Not sure if the large or the XL I got were defective, but they are all getting sent back.

Title: Must have summer dress!
Review: This dress is one of the best dresses I've ordered from Amazon.  The fit is perfect for a medium and the fabric is super soft and comfortable.  It is beautifully sewn with a side zipper and pockets ( which I usually don't like because it makes the dress bulky but Amazon Essentials did a great job making it).

Title: Love it
Review: Well made, has a zipper and also has pockets that are stitched in well so they don’t bunch out and look bad on your hips. Quality fabric which I swear is hard to come by, the neck line is flattering and I love the length. My only complaint is I wish it came in more colors !

Title: this is a wonderful flattering comfortable dress
Review: Thus fits as expected and is a dress that you can wear anywhere. You could pair it with heels or sneakers  - you can dress it up or wear it extremely casually around the house. I highly recommend it ..it’s well-made. I highly recommend.

Title: Weird fit
Review: Medium too tight in chest, large too big overall!

Title: Pretty & Comfortable

Material is lightweight, breathable, and soft but not sheer or see-through.The pockets are cut well so it’s still flattering on the hips and neckline is a nice level if you do not want to show cleavage (even for larger chests!) straps are thick enough to cover bra straps.I loved it so much I bought another color!

Title: Super cute dress
Review: I was influenced to get this dress from an Instagram person. I got it in both yellow and green. Sizing is generous and the yellow seems to run a tad larger than the green. Great for a beach trip or wear to work with a sweater.

I feel like it runs a tiny bit big -I’m 5’4” and 105 lbs and got the XS. There is a little extra room everywhere including the bust - I’m a 32D-34C. That being said, it is 102 today where I live and I’ve been wearing it all day for lunch with a friend and errands so the little bit of extra room is probably a good thing. Overall happy with the purchase and may go back for another color.

The armpits have no downward cutout so they do rise a little high, the tradeoff is that the bra is not exposed.  I'd like to see this dress available in more colors.

Title: No sucking in with this dress!
Review: I’m 5’6” and 145 lbs (bottom heavy). I’m always between sizes. Sometimes between medium and small. Sometimes between medium and large. Since this is a tent dress, it was between medium and small. The dress on the left is the medium and the dress on the right is the small. The biggest differences are the length and the top. I hate my knees. I can’t explain it. I don’t pretend that that’s a normal feeling, but here we are. I have avoided shorts and dresses shorter than midi length for most of my life. BUT I live in south Louisiana and it’s just too hot for all that nonsense, and I’m older and wiser now. So you can see the difference in length. I think in real life it’s only an inch, but to me that’s the difference between being comfortable and not being comfortable. The second thing that you probably can’t see is the top part is a little tighter. Although I probably would have liked how the top fit better, the length won the toss up. If you actually have anything bigger than an A cup keep the top in mind. I am a 34A (so is my 11 year old), so I don’t usually have to worry about tops being “too tight”. The mid section doesn’t touch me at all so I like that part because I don’t have to hold anything in or wear a torture device. This color is nice and the material is so soft. I’ll probably wear a slip because it’s a little sheer and being an educator I cannot take that chance because too many teenagers have phones. I wouldn’t give it a 5 because unless you are a toothpick I wouldn’t use “flattering” to describe it, but it’s a keeper because it’s easy and comfortable and the price is nice.

I am a size 10 but a toned and tight 10. I am also losing weight. Because of this, I know that can impact sizing so I ordered a medium instead of my normal large. I have a butt and am pretty busty. This dress clings to my butt. I'm not crazy about this but as I lose more weight, that problem will be saved. But then in the chest, it is also too large. I am a DD so a medium should not be too large. It should fit more like in the butt area. Then under the breast, it is very loose. The fabric is very stretchy though so I would almost say that the medium should be for someone wearing a 12 or 14 if they wanted a fitted look. The sizing is just very off and odd for my body. First, it runs a little big which wouldn’t be a problem if it would just stay on.  It’s a wrap dress and has a button where to the two sides of the dress meet BUT the button hole is a little big so the button keeps slipping out of the hole.  The button is necessary because the fabric is very slippery so you can’t rely on the tie to keep the dress from falling open.  Without the button fastened, the V-neck opens up and you reveal more than I care to in public.  My solution has been to put a safety pin where the button is AND another one keeping the V-neck together.  (FYI: I do not have a large chest, so I can’t imagine how someone larger than me would keep from falling out of this dress.)The bottom line is:  It’s a beautiful and flattering dress but I shouldn’t need to pin it together every time I put it on.
